description: Out-of-scope fail-open: unrecognized `RequestOrReplied` value (typo / future verdict not in the canonical set). The hook does NOT validate the verdict word itself — that is `validate_pr_review`'s responsibility. Returns None and lets the comment through. (Body shape would post-#244-block under verdict scope: Requestor.lastname=Virtanen matches branch-author.lastname=Virtanen — but the unknown direction triggers early-return-None before the heuristic runs.)
command:
gh pr comment 42 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Requestor: Aino Virtanen
Requestee: Aino Virtanen
RequestOrReplied: Asdf
TechDebt: none
EOF
)"
